persos.desc: landlord in his 60s, tangerine-and-ochre suit, round glasses, pointing up
persos.pose: standing on the left, pointing up at the empty socket

persos.desc: tenant in his 30s, mustard-and-magenta tracksuit, wide innocent eyes, hands on his chest
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the right, very innocent

dialogue: Qui a volé l'ampoule du couloir-là, hein ?!
C'est pas moi, Tonton ! D'ailleurs, elle éclaire mal dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. Both keep a three-quarter view toward the camera so the lips of the speaker are visible. The landlord points at the empty socket and shouts. The tenant puts both hands on his chest and swears his innocence with wide eyes, his face clearly visible.
chute: The landlord slowly lowers his finger and stares at the tenant; the tenant's innocent smile freezes as he realises what he said. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the innocent tenant's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE LOCATAIRE APRÈS SON AVEU :
mecanisme: aveu involontaire : l'innocent connaît la qualité de l'objet volé
